item.title: Private AI for your team, on a machine you control

item.title: One binary, four runtimes, any machine: what dxflow is
item.description: The engine under DiPhyx runs the same on a laptop, a GPU server, an HPC node and a cloud VM. Here is what it does, why it is one file, and what a workflow looks like.

item.title: A GPU in a minute: the cloud, without the cloud account
item.description: How DiPhyx turns 'I need a machine for an afternoon' into one click, one hour, one line on a prepaid balance.
